top_signals.title: BOE Sees Case for Another Rate Hike If Iran War Doesn't End
top_signals.summary: "I'm not going to sign up to the two-and-done point," Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey says when asked if a second interest-rate increase is on the cards following Thursday's decision to hike. "Absent a resolution of the conflict in the Middle East, and I think I put this in my commentary in the minutes, I could see the case for a further 25 [basis points]," Bailey says at a news conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: European Gas Prices Drop on Iran Deal Hopes after U.S. Midterms
